rotate_neox_apply_rotary_embedding: apply Neox-style rotary embedding by rotating half dimensions of a tensor
rotate_gptj_apply_rotary_embedding: apply GPT-J-style rotary embedding by interleaving and rotating half dimensions of a tensor
apply_rotary_emb_compute_rotary: compute rotary embedding on input tensor using cos and sin with neox or gptj style
apply_rotary_pos_emb_native_apply_rotary: apply rotary positional embedding to query and key tensors in native float precision
apply_rotary_pos_emb_npu_apply_rotary: apply rotary positional embedding on Ascend NPU hardware using npu_rotary_mul kernel
